_comment: Copy this file to config.json and edit it. config.json is gitignored.
Credentials are NOT stored here. Set FMX_EMAIL and FMX_PASSWORD as environment
variables, or pass --env-file, or let the script prompt you.
Run --discover to see which modules your tenant actually has, and to get a
ready-to-paste version of the list below.
_modules_comment: name    = the folder created under outputDirectory, and the --modules selector.
apiPath = the real API path. These are NOT derivable from the module name:
the Schedule module lives at /scheduling/requests, and
fields  = which parts of each record to fetch. This is REQUIRED, not an
optimisation: attachments added to a response or comment live on the
record's actions, and actions are not in the default payload. Without
the actions(...) expansion below, those attachments are invisible.
It also shrinks responses enormously (one module: 12.4 MB -> 297 KB).
Beware: this API silently ignores field names it does not recognise,
so a typo means missing attachments, not an error. The script warns
if a projected collection never comes back.
Modules your tenant does not have simply 404 and are skipped.

modules._comment: Occurrences inherit their parent's attachments, so a daily recurring schedule would write one copy per occurrence. Off unless you truly want that.
modules.name: schedule-occurrences

modules._comment: User attachments are more likely to be personal (certifications, contracts). Opt in deliberately.
modules.name: users
